interface.title: PathogenWatch BD: influenza surveillance (WHO FluNet)
interface.stage_of_work: Checking data quality, then analysis and interpretation of a weekly surveillance time series (description, seasonality, outbreak-signal screening, detector evaluation, short-term forecast benchmark)
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit dashboard that turns a cleaned WHO FluNet country-week export into influenza positivity trends with confidence intervals, a seasonal decomposition, EARS/CUSUM alert screening, detector evaluation, a one-week-ahead forecast benchmark and a documented data-quality audit.

data.note: The app loads a seeded synthetic Bangladesh (BGD) series of 160 weeks (2021 to January 2024). It has a missing week and a single injected spike in the week of 2022-03-07 (35% positivity). Overview, Seasonality, Anomaly detection and Forecast benchmark are computed live from it. The Evaluation tables and the Data quality report are pre-generated from the project's original real-data run, so they do not match the seeded data: the report describes 189,630 rows, 189 countries, ISO weeks 1995 to 2026, and evaluates over 693 weeks from 2012-12-31. The Country/area dropdown offers only Bangladesh (BGD). On this seeded series the Random Forest beats the last-week baseline on the one-week-ahead holdout (MAE 1.22 vs 1.37), which is the reverse of the real-data result the README records; the README's main forecast result, a rolling one-step-ahead backtest, is produced by the pipeline but not shown in the UI.

features.name: Proportion time series with confidence band, denominator bars, latest-week cards and annual summary
features.general: Plot a weekly rate with its 95% confidence band above a bar chart of the denominator on a shared time axis, hover any week for its value, hide or show the band, and read the latest week's values and a per-year summary with intervals
features.specific: Overview tab: positivity (influenza-positive / specimens processed) line with 95% CI ribbon over Processed bars, KPI cards for the latest complete week, and the Annual positivity (valid weeks only) table
steps: Hover the line or a bar to read the week, positivity or specimens processed
Click the '95% CI' legend item to hide or show the band (the y-axis rescales; on replay it took a second click)
Read the latest-week KPI cards (fixed at the last complete week, whatever the year range)
Read the annual positivity table with pos_lo/pos_hi and share_A/share_B
serves_tasks: Inspect the weekly positivity trend with its confidence band and denominator
Read the latest complete week's positivity and testing volume
Compare annual positivity and the type A/B split with confidence intervals

features.name: Multi-detector aberration overlay with adjustable threshold
features.general: Run several outbreak-detection algorithms on a time series, mark the flagged points on the series in a colour per detector, optionally re-score with a custom z threshold, and tally flagged weeks per detector in a copyable summary
features.specific: Anomaly detection tab: Detectors multiselect (C1, C2, C3, CUSUM, Select all, clear), the 'Re-score EARS with custom threshold' checkbox with an EARS z threshold slider (2.00–5.00), positivity chart with C1/C2/C3 alert diamonds, and the 'Alert weeks in the selected period' JSON with a copy button
steps: Choose detectors in the multiselect (or Select all / clear)
Optionally tick custom threshold and drag the z slider
Read the alert diamonds on the positivity line; click legend entries to hide a detector
Box-zoom on a flagged week and hover the marker for its date and value; double-click to reset
Read or copy the per-detector alert-week counts
serves_tasks: Run one or more aberration detectors and see where they flag weeks
Change the alert threshold and see how many weeks are flagged
Inspect a single flagged week closely
Copy the alert tallies for reporting

features.name: Seasonal decomposition panel with seasonality tests and peak table
features.general: Split a periodic series into trend, seasonal and residual components in stacked linked plots, report a formal test of seasonality, and list each cycle's peak timing and height
features.specific: Seasonality tab: robust STL Trend/Seasonal/Residual subplots, a line with the harmonic quasi-binomial GLM vs null and Kruskal-Wallis month test, and a per-ISO_YEAR peak_week/peak_positivity/valid_weeks table; the plot can be exported as PNG
steps: Open the decomposition and hover the seasonal panel to read peak timing
Check the residual panel for one-off spikes
Read the harmonic GLM quasi-F and Kruskal-Wallis results
Read the per-year peak week table (hide columns if needed)
Export the figure as a PNG
serves_tasks: Inspect the trend, seasonal and residual components of the decomposed series
Test whether seasonality and a month effect are statistically supported, and find each year's peak week
Export the decomposition figure

features.name: Detector evaluation tables (proxy episodes and simulation)
features.general: Compare candidate detection methods on sensitivity, timeliness and false-alarm rate, against reference episodes and against simulated outbreaks of increasing size, by sorting and searching interactive tables
features.specific: Evaluation tab: Table A 'Real data vs proxy reference episodes' (episodes detected, sensitivity, median/mean delay, alerts outside episodes, false alerts per 52 weeks) and Table B 'Semi-synthetic simulation' (scenario × detector × odds ratio), each with sort-by-header, Search, Show/hide columns and Fullscreen
steps: Read the caveat banner (no labelled outbreaks)
Scroll Table A sideways to compare sensitivity against false alerts per 52 weeks
Click a column header in Table B to sort (e.g. by sensitivity)
Search the table for one detector to highlight its rows
serves_tasks: Judge detector reliability against proxy episodes and simulated outbreaks

features.name: Baseline-vs-model forecast benchmark on a chronological holdout
features.general: Compare naive one-step-ahead forecasts (last week, and same week last year) and a machine-learning model on held-out recent weeks: side-by-side error metrics, an observed-vs-predicted overlay with toggleable series, a per-week prediction table, and run metadata with feature importances
features.specific: Forecast benchmark tab: Last-week baseline and Random Forest JSON cards (mae, rmse, r2), Observed / Last-week baseline / Random Forest chart of influenza-positive detections, a week_start/actual/baseline_last_week/baseline_seasonal_52_week/random_forest_prediction table (the seasonal lag-52 baseline is listed but not scored in the cards), and JSON with n_usable/n_train/n_test/split_method/feature_importance
steps: Read the paired metric cards
Hide or show series in the overlay chart via the legend to compare one model with the observed values
Scan the per-week prediction table, including the seasonal lag-52 baseline column
Check sample sizes and feature importances in the run JSON
serves_tasks: Compare error metrics of the baseline and the model on held-out weeks
Inspect predictions week by week against observed values
Compare a seasonal-naive baseline (same week one year earlier) with the observed values
Check training sample size and which predictors mattered

features.name: Data-cleaning audit report
features.general: A rendered, versioned report that documents a raw file's checksum, duplicates, conflicting-source handling policy, missingness, consistency-rule violations, location-specific breaks and limitations, so downstream numbers can be traced to cleaning decisions
features.specific: Data quality tab: 'Data Quality Report: WHO FluNet VIW_FNT.csv' with raw SHA-256, sections 1 Dataset overview, 2.1–2.5 findings tables (exact duplicates, NOTDEFINED/SENTINEL/NONSENTINEL combinations and over-count by country, missing_pct, logical consistency checks, Bangladesh source periods and missing weeks) and 3 Limitations
steps: Check the raw-file hash and dataset overview
Review duplicate and source-conflict findings and the applied policy
Review missingness and recovered values
Review the consistency-check violation counts
Read the location-specific breaks and limitations
serves_tasks: Review dataset size, duplicate records and conflicting source rows, and the rule used to resolve them
Review missingness, recovered values and internal-consistency violations
Check location-specific caveats and stated limitations

features.name: Shared location and time-range filter
